title: SHIPPING & DELIVERY POLICY
officialText:
At Cozeware, we are dedicated to providing a seamless and reliable shopping experience for every customer. To ensure faster delivery and higher satisfaction, we operate eight strategically located warehouses across the United States, enabling us to process and ship orders efficiently nationwide. Most regions within the U.S. enjoy Free Shipping, with the exception of the following locations: HI, PR, AK, GU, AE, VI, FM, MP and APO/FPO.
Notice: All orders are fulfilled by FedEx. Please note that deliveries may be subject to delays during holidays. We kindly ask customers not to provide P.O. Box addresses or locations classified as remote areas (including HI, PR, AK, GU, APO/FPO/AE, VI, FM, MP).
SHIPPING STRATEGY
To deliver the best service possible, Cozeware ships products from the warehouse closest to the customer's delivery address. This approach minimizes transit time and enhances delivery reliability.
We guarantee that no additional fees will be applied for this optimized shipping method.
Shipping Methods and Shipping Time:
Shipping Methods
Working Time
Delivery Time
FedEx GroundMon. to Fri.3 -7 Days
FedEx HomeMon. to Sun.4 -7 Days
Delivery to States（A - Z):
Alabama, Arizona, Arkansas, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Lousiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Mississippi, Missouri, Montana, Nebraska, Nevada, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New Mexico, New York, North Carolina, North, Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah,
IMPORTANT NOTICE:
Note 1: In the case of purchasing a pre-sale / pre-order product, please note that the item will be shipped within 48 hours once it becomes available in stock.
Note 2: We would like to inform you that shipment dates provided for all orders are estimates. Delays may occur due to unforeseen circumstances beyond our control, such as force majeure events, natural disasters, inclement weather, war, public holidays, and other factors. If you have any inquiries or require the latest information, please do not hesitate to contact us at service@cozeware.com or call +1 877-801-8599.
